scope: Pinned TMDb Helper 6.21.5 skin contract plus native current-provider follow-up in an owned isolated profile. Original source model and earlier installed 5.4.16 checks retained as separate evidence.

sources.finding: Manifest identifies the checked upstream version as 6.21.5.
The skin service opt-in is still TMDbHelper.Service.
The receiving container selector remains Skin.String(TMDbHelper.MonitorContainer).
Selector is converted to an integer; receiver must be visible; the active-window control receives the ListItem through addItem. Exit sends an empty ListItem.
Container finalisation delivers the populated ListItem to that control.
Provider metadata maps the icon field to the provider logo and uses the provider property prefix.
Property enumeration begins at one and materialises indexed provider property names.
WINDOW_XML_MEDIA omits MyFavourites.xml; non-empty WidgetContainer string enables polling. Listitem branch precedes clear branch.
widget_id converts property to int; container(0) returns Container. and preserves the native default view.
WindowChecker.get_window_property defaults to string; get_property accepts explicit int conversion. String zero opts in while integer zero selects default container.

kodi_property_case_source.finding: ListItem properties use CaseInsensitiveCompare. The skin's Provider.N.Icon casing and the producer's provider.N.icon casing are compatible.

checked_contracts.assessment: Actual skin initialization enables TMDbHelper.Service with current provider; initial failed run used a disabled test-skin registry and was not a skin defect.
Native current-provider test reads selector 99950 and receives real movie 603 data.

checked_contracts.skin: List 99950, 1 by 1 pixels, off-screen, with no explicit false visibility
checked_contracts.assessment: Native Control.IsVisible(99950) is true; actual 6.21.5 service delivers title, base label, TMDb id and eight provider icon fields.

checked_contracts.skin: MyVideoNav.xml and MyFavourites.xml include the receiver when the addon is enabled.
checked_contracts.assessment: MyVideoNav delivers real metadata/icons. MyFavourites activation and actual base-label delivery pass globally and locally; observed untyped plugin-folder favourite has no movie id and correctly clears prior movie icons.
All eight one-based fields queried using skin casing are populated; actual HorizonzV screenshot renders eight icons.

checked_contracts.skin: Empty icon properties hide their image controls.
checked_contracts.assessment: Actual transitions from movie data to the untyped favourite replace base label, clear title/id and all eight icon fields; Home opt-in clears on unload. Earlier native 5.4.16 report also verifies both named window properties clear.

conclusion: Current-provider native data confirms the retained service, receiver and indexed icon contracts. Added Favourites opt-in is recognized by original 6.21.5 Poller in both modes; real service replaces prior movie data/icons with the untyped favourite base label. No further production change required by this pass.
limits: One real movie, default test settings and one untyped plugin-folder favourite; not all titles, regions or favourite metadata variants.
No playback, Disney+ or account-authenticated backend test.
Standard TMDb Helper remains 5.4.16; current 6.21.5 and byte-equal dependencies are retained only in the owned test profile.
No external addon source corrected; SDK inspector adjusts its own import path only.

native_followup.scope: Real TMDb 603 metadata and eight icon fields delivered to actual skin receiver; screenshot rendered. Original Poller with actual Kodi API and live receiver label transitions verified in Favourites global/local modes. Settings/favourites restored, addon sources unchanged.

previous_native_followup.scope: Visible standard Kodi: actual XML onload/onunload dispatch and receiver visibility in both widget modes. Not 6.21.5 service execution or actual online data delivery.
